messages.subject: Error Model visualization
messages.body_plain:
Dear Wallace users,

I am experiencing an issue when attempting to visualize a model in the Visualize module. When I run the visualization command in R, Wallace freezes and the following message is displayed:
Warning in file(fn, "rb") :
  no fue posible abrir el archivo 'C:\Users\Usuario\AppData\Local\Temp\RtmpOCgZ62\raster\r_tmp_2023-12-06_182313.966283_3984_01329.gri': No such file or directory
Warning: Error in file: no se puede abrir la conexión

I run the latest Wallace version.

Any idea?

JL

messages.subject: Re: Error Model visualization
messages.body_plain:
Are you having this issue within Wallace? Or running an RMD of a session code?

This usually happens when the rasters aren't in the temporary storage anymore and might need to be loaded in again. Were you using the option to load a previous session? You might just need to return to the env data component and load your rasters in again.

-Bethany

messages.subject: Error trying to upload occ data
messages.subject_clean: Error trying to upload occ data
messages.body_plain:
Hello fellow Wallace users,

I am having problems uploading the occurrence data for the species that I am trying to model. The same error keeps happening, even after I corrected what the message said. This is the message: ! ERROR: Please input a file with columns "scientific_name", "longitude", "latitude".
I am using the latest Wallace version (2.1.1).

If anyone could help me, I would be very thankful.
Best regards,
Gabriel Yan

messages.subject: Re: Error trying to upload occ data
messages.subject_clean: Error trying to upload occ data
messages.body_plain:
Check to make sure the occ data file is a comma-separated values file (.csv), that the columns headers do not have the quotation marks (" "), and that the species' names in the scientific_name column are listed as Genus species, and not with an underscore.
For a sample of how it should look, see: Bassaricyon_alleni.csv <https://github.com/wallaceEcoMod/wallace/blob/master/inst/extdata/Bassaricyon_alleni.csv>

Bethany
The Wallace Team
